timestamp_semantics: Monotonic logical append time after Campaign284; not a market-data measurement.
objective: Freeze a finite priority-ordered catalog of issuer external-state mechanisms before targeted Campaign285 inventory.

catalog_selection_rule.selection_method: Select the first priority route that is economically independent and has a lawful complete 2019-2023 point-in-time issuer identity, revision, availability and denominator contract; otherwise stop before formula, direction, fields, rows or values.

concept_catalog.economic_state: Issuer labor capacity reflected in public collective-bargaining, strike, lockout, settlement, ratification and return-to-work lifecycle records.
Issuer transaction and asset-control access reflected in public foreign-investment review, mitigation, prohibition, divestment and clearance states.
Issuer production capacity reflected in public water-right allocation, drought curtailment, emergency restriction, compliance and restoration states.
Issuer generation or fuel-cycle capacity reflected in public safeguards finding, mandated outage, remediation, inspection and restart authorization states.
Issuer space-asset commissioning reflected in public launch authorization, range scheduling, scrub, retry, launch and deployment states.
Issuer exclusionary operating rights reflected in public patent validity, injunction, stay, appeal, remand and restored-enforcement states.
Issuer public-sector market access reflected in public debarment, suspension, remedial agreement, reinstatement and procurement-eligibility states.
